pandas.read_table

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Read delimited text into a DataFrame. The default delimiter is a tab.

Call syntax

pd.read_table(…) Full signature
pd.read_table(
    filepath_or_buffer,
    *,
    sep=…,
    delimiter=…,
    header='infer',
    names=…,
    index_col=None,
    usecols=None,
    dtype=None,
    engine=None,
    converters=None,
    true_values=None,
    false_values=None,
    skipinitialspace=False,
    skiprows=None,
    skipfooter=0,
    nrows=None,
    na_values=None,
    keep_default_na=True,
    na_filter=True,
    skip_blank_lines=True,
    parse_dates=None,
    date_format=None,
    dayfirst=False,
    cache_dates=True,
    iterator=False,
    chunksize=None,
    compression='infer',
    thousands=None,
    decimal='.',
    lineterminator=None,
    quotechar='"',
    quoting=0,
    doublequote=True,
    escapechar=None,
    comment=None,
    encoding=None,
    encoding_errors='strict',
    dialect=None,
    on_bad_lines='error',
    low_memory=True,
